title: Reinstatement After Repossession: Repossession and Collateral Recovery Terms
content:
Terms under which a borrower may reinstate a contract after repossession under Repossession and Collateral Recovery and get the vehicle back.

**1. Status.** Reinstatement is quoted and completed only on a case in recovered status, as the case record shows it.

**2. Availability.** The company offers reinstatement in every state, but only while the contract's reinstatements across all its cases are fewer than the class maximum of one reinstatement per contract and the contract is not charged off; once the limit is reached the borrower may only redeem.

**3. Reinstatement amount.** The reinstatement amount is every installment due on the contract through the quote's good-through date (the scheduled payment for each due date from the next due date through that date, less the partial installment credit), plus the contract's fees due, plus the case's recovery expenses outstanding through that date including storage accrued to it; the accelerated balance is never required. The recovery expenses outstanding are the expenses posted on the case less those removed and settled (the case's outstanding figure), plus storage accrued but not yet posted through that date at the class day fee for each chargeable day.

**4. Quote validity.** A quote is good through the earlier of the quote date plus 5 days (the class quote validity) and the day before the earliest sale date.

**5. Payment and release.** Payment is accepted only through the certified payment channels. The vehicle is released within 2 business days after good funds, and only when accepted proof of the borrower's own physical-damage insurance is on the contract's insurance tracking record.

**Retired clauses — no longer in force.** The following sentences of the original terms are no longer in force and have been superseded by the current basis:

- "The reinstatement payment must be received before the earliest sale date, which falls the class minimum notice period after the notice of intent to sell was mailed. That period is counted in calendar days from the mailing date of the latest notice of intent to sell, and a payment on the earliest sale date itself is too late." — no longer in force.
- "the contract portion posts to the contract as a reinstatement payment and the expense portion settles the case's expenses" — no longer in force.

## Quote validity, worked (hypothetical dates)

| Quote date | Earliest sale date | Quote date plus 5 days | Day before the sale date | Good through |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 10 April | 13 April | 15 April | 12 April | 12 April |
| 10 April | 30 April | 15 April | 29 April | 15 April |

## Availability, as a table

| Reinstatements already on the contract | Contract charged off | Reinstatement available |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | no | yes |
| 0 | yes | no — redemption only |
| 1 | no | no — redemption only |
